efficiencies.name: defefficiency

efficiencies.name: totefficiencyrank

predictives.name: fpi
predictives.description: Football Power Index that measures team's true strength on net points scale; expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

predictives.name: fpirank
predictives.description: Football Power Index Rank vs all FBS teams.

predictives.name: projectedw
predictives.description: Projected overall W-L, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (and potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

predictives.name: projectedl
predictives.description: Projected overall Losses, accounting for results to date and FPI-based projections for remaining scheduled games (including potential conference championship games). May not sum to a whole number because of differing number of games played in each simulation.

predictives.name: probwinout
predictives.description: Percent of season simulations in which team won all remaining scheduled games as well as conference championship game (if applicable).

predictives.name: probwinconf

predictives.name: sosremainingrank

predictives.name: adjlosses

predictives.name: avgingamewprank

predictives.description: Game Control rank. Reflects chance that an average Top 25 team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

predictives.name: adjavgingamewp
predictives.description: Team's average in-game win probability adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

predictives.name: avgingamewp
predictives.description: Team's average in-game win probability across all plays of all games played, not adjusted for site or opponent.

predictives.name: avgingamewprank
predictives.description: Team's average in-game win probability rank adjusted for chance that an average FBS team would control games from start to end the way this team did, given the schedule.

predictives.name: avgsosrank
predictives.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an average Top 25 team.

predictives.name: topsosrank
predictives.description: Rank among all FBS teams of games already played schedule strength, from perspective of an top FBS team.

predictives.name: epaoffense
predictives.description: Offensive component of FPI. Offensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

predictives.name: epadefense
predictives.description: Defensive component of FPI. Defensive contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

predictives.name: epaspecialteams
predictives.description: Special teams component of FPI. Special teams contribution to expected point margin vs average opponent on neutral field.

predictives.name: probwindiv

predictives.name: probmakeplayoffs

efficiencies.name: offefficiency
efficiencies.description: Offensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on offense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing defenses faced.

efficiencies.name: offefficiencyrank
efficiencies.description: Team's offensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

efficiencies.name: defefficiency
efficiencies.description: Defensive efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on defense's contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing offenses faced.

efficiencies.name: defefficiencyrank
efficiencies.description: Team's defensive efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

efficiencies.name: stefficiency
efficiencies.description: Special teams efficiency on 0-100 scale; based on special teams' contribution to scoring margin on per-play basis, adjusted for strength of opposing special teams faced.

efficiencies.name: stefficiencyrank
efficiencies.description: Team's special teams efficiency rank among all FBS teams.

efficiencies.name: totefficiency
efficiencies.description: Net efficiency on 0-100 scale; incorporates offense, defense and special teams efficiencies into a single schedule-adjusted measure of per-play efficiency.

efficiencies.name: totefficiencyrank
efficiencies.description: Team's overall efficiency rank among all FBS teams.
